findingDetails.title: The worktree search reads only the last 16 MB of the session log, so a long session loses the goal the phase exists to carry
The two-worktree refusal always reports 2 packets even when more worktrees carry the headline

results.notes: REQ-001 through REQ-004 are implemented; the bounded tail narrows the REQ-001 phrase about worktrees the session log names to the last 16 MB.
T003 through T007 are backed by new tests; the T010 real-session probe is packet evidence only and was not re-measured here.

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to this run: the bounded-tail asymmetry between logTailText and latestGoalLogEntry, and the early-return count in the new worktree refusal message. No prior iteration exists to refine.
classification: correctness: one P1 (bounded log tail) and one P2 (refusal count) in the new worktree goal path
ruledOut: goal_root written unquoted into the frontmatter follows the existing cwd convention
GIT_CONFIG_* cannot redirect git worktree list away from the repository -C names
a goal_root naming a worktree of another repository never matches git worktree list
the seeded two-line protocol leaves goal_root empty on a packet-only reply
